description: Buy WHOIS privacy (ID protection) for a domain — replaces the registrant's name, address, phone and e-mail in the public WHOIS with the privacy service's own. This is the thing to offer a customer who cares about not being personally listed against their domain. Costs money, charged to the account balance, so top up first with impreza_topup if it is short. Not available on every TLD, and some registries publish nothing anyway. Requires the 'manage' scope. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. COSTS MONEY — takes two calls: the first is a QUOTE that charges nothing and returns the price plus a confirm_token, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and buys. Purchases also count against a daily spend ceiling on the credential.
name: impreza_domain_id_protection
title: Buy WHOIS privacy
